decision_conditions:
Condition : 1 - Reason for Approval

The proposed four 50 seater tiered stands, by way of their size, scale, design and location would not represent an obtrusive design and would not have an adverse impact upon the general amenity of the immediate locality and would complement the sites exiting use as a football ground while respecting the open, spacious nature of the greenbelt area within which it is located and is therefore in accordance with Adopted UDP policies ENV-B.1.1 (All New Developments) ENV-N.1.2 (Acceptable Development in the Green Belt) and C.5.4 (New Small Private Sports and Leisure Facilities) of the London Borough of Hounslow UDP, Adopted December 2003.
Condition : 2 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of five years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority.
Condition : 4 - No demolition or construction work shall take place on the site except between the hours of 8am  to 6pm Monday to Friday and 8am to 1pm on Saturdays.

Condition : 5 - The site shall be investigated for landfill gas to the satisfaction of the Local Planning Authority and details of the test results and measures required to render the development safe shall be submitted to and approved by the Local Planning Authority before the development is commenced.

Where measures are required, they shall be installed before the development is occupied or such other time as may be required by the Local Planning Authority
description: Erection of 4 no. 50 seater tiered stands to existing football club.
